precision: FP64 only, same unfused gates, no reordered arithmetic
primary_comparator: synchronous multi-gate residency at the same tile split
candidate: event-ordered ring applies maximal low-only runs per load; high gates flush; shallow segments use synchronous fallback
go_gate: >=1.05x median end-to-end improvement over synchronous residency in at least one held-out deep-pipeline cell, with all four paired block ratios >1; no-go is acceptable
held_out: unfused QFT n=24 m=20 (same natural ordering, no SWAP relabeling)
measurement: four mirrored three-arm blocks, rotate leading arm and reverse cell order, all samples retained; one measured run per process after backend compilation, includes pinned/ring allocation, initialization and final stream drain, excludes norm/export
controls: per-gate synchronous measured separately on training/alternating cells; no multiplication of historical speedups
resource_limits: host state <=1 GiB, ring <=1 GiB in timings; check available memory first, no forced OOM or service/clock changes
correctness: forced small tiles, complete FP64 amplitudes vs CPU and synchronous paging, finite errors <=1e-10, norm/reversibility, mixed control/target and high/high flush paths, ring reuse and invalid input rejection
stage_accounting: separate allocation/init, total execution/drain endpoint; analytical full-state bytes/pass/group/launch counts labelled model, matched profiler trace if available; never label model counters as observed bandwidth
equal_ring_payload_control: same circuit with fixed HOT=m, synchronous residency at m+2 vs combined at m on both deep locality cells; gates crossing to n-1 remain high. Include in decision assessment; reject apparent benefit if dominated by this same-payload synchronous configuration.
models: Circuit low hot region fixed independently of tile split; high targets at n-1/n-2; four layers with deterministic angles. These forced-paging states fit device; no out-of-core reach claim.
